user.title: IRTrans direct connection
user.description: Enter the IRTrans device address. Codes are stored in Home Assistant. No irserver or hardware IR database is required. The device must send received binary IR data to the Home Assistant IP and receive port.

error.cannot_connect: No valid binary TCP response from IRTrans. Check the device address and TCP port 21000.

abort.already_configured: This IRTrans device is already configured.
